racialAbility.name: Stone Form
racialAbility.description: Turn to stone, removing all harmful Disease, Electricity, and Poison effects and increasing your resistance to them, reducing your Physical Damage received by 10%, and increasing your Armor Class by 25% for 15 seconds.

racialAbility.name: Slippery
racialAbility.description: Become slippery, removing all Root and Snare effects and granting you immunity to them for 15 seconds.

racialAbility.name: Bribe
racialAbility.description: Bribe your target, causing them to forget past wrongdoings.

racialAbility.name: Sneak
racialAbility.description: Walk silently, rendering you undetectable to targets while behind them.

racialAbility.name: Tenacity
racialAbility.description: Become tenacious, removing all Mesmerize and Incapacitate effects and granting you immunity to them for 15 seconds.

racialAbility.name: Ogre Smash
racialAbility.description: Forcefully smash nearby targets, stunning them for 2 seconds.

racialAbility.name: Hide
racialAbility.description: Slip into the shadows, rendering you unseen by the living.

classes.name: Bard
classes.bonusPointsAdvice: Listed below is the recommended allocation of bonus points by race. Since Charisma is a Bard’s main attribute, you should focus on maximizing it whenever possible. Most of your songs' effectiveness are tied to it. The remaining points are flexible as it is currently unknown how or if songs are affected by the other stats. As more information comes to light, this section will be appropriately updated. * Note: Mana total is only affected by the higher stat between intelligence and wisdom. ''' Dwar

classes.name: Cleric
classes.bonusPointsAdvice: Listed below is the recommended allocation of bonus points by race. Since Wisdom is a Cleric’s main attribute, you should focus on maximizing it whenever possible. Wisdom is directly tied to your healing spells effectiveness and total mana. After that, prioritize Stamina. It gives you extra HP and a bit of stun resistance. Finally, put a point into Dexterity if you have any left. It affects hit rate across the board and increases your proc chance. ''' Dwarf: +2 Stamina and +8 Wisdom Gnome: +2 St

classes.name: Druid
classes.bonusPointsAdvice: Listed below is the recommended allocation of bonus points by race. Since Wisdom is a Druid’s main attribute, you should focus on maximizing it whenever possible. Wisdom is directly tied to your healing spells effectiveness and total mana. After that, prioritize Charisma. It helps with the Druid's charm line of spells, along with a few other spell lines. Finally, put a point into Dexterity if you have any left. It affects hit rate across the board and increases your proc chance. ''' Goblin: +1 D

classes.name: Enchanter
classes.bonusPointsAdvice: Below is the recommended allocation of bonus points by race. Since Intelligence is a Enchanter’s main attribute, you should focus on maximizing it whenever possible. As an Enchanter you are the best crowd controller in the game, and both your Charm and Mesmerize line of skills rely on this stat. ''' Dwarf: +5 Intelligence and +5 Charisma Gnome: +5 Intelligence and +5 Charisma Goblin: +5 Intelligence and +5
